description: Debug and modify an ext2/ext3/ext4 file system interactively.

option.name: -b
tip: Force the file system block size.

option.name: -c
tip: Open the file system in catastrophic mode.

option.name: -d
tip: Use this device when reading blocks not found in the image.

option.name: -D
tip: Open the device using direct I/O.

option.name: -f
tip: Read and execute commands from the file.

option.name: -i
tip: Treat the device as an e2image image file.

option.name: -R
tip: Execute a single request and exit.
See debugfs(8) for the request syntax.

option.name: -s
tip: Read the superblock from this block number.

option.name: -V
tip: Print the version number and exit.

option.name: -w
tip: Open the file system in read-write mode.

option.name: -z
tip: Write the old contents of each block to an undo file.
